scope: Relevance review of all 38 publications previously discussed in Chapter 2. Targeted primary-source checks and existing sourced notes, not new experimental reproduction or a full reread of every paper. Publication age alone does not determine relevance. No claim of current state-of-the-art ranking.
criteria: Fit to multi-day archive retrieval and repeated questions

papers.heading: TVR / XML: a historical corpus-localization reference
papers.reason: Historical task decomposition remains useful, but original features and edited television do not provide the preferred archive implementation.

papers.heading: EventFormer: an event index before precise localization
